summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) Radix mobile menu a11y fix and (2) self-hosted fonts migration on Sole Serenity. All checks passed: no Radix DialogTitle/Description console warnings on mobile menu open, sr-only 'Navigation menu' SheetTitle present with proper aria-labelledby/aria-describedby, zero network calls to fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com, /fonts.css + 7 /fonts/*.woff2 all return 200, hero H1 renders with 'Bebas Neue' computed font-family. Mobile menu navigation closes after link click and routes to /services; desktop header BOOK button renders; Services/Contact routes load without console errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 390x844 shows the mobile menu (lg:hidden). Opening via [data-testid=mobile-nav-open-button] triggers a Radix Sheet with aria-labelledby (sr-only h2 'Navigation menu') and aria-describedby. Fonts self-hosted at /fonts/*.woff2 via /fonts.css — verified 0 Google Fonts requests. 9 woff2 responses observed (JetBrains Mono 400 + Space Grotesk 400/500 fetched twice, likely preload+use; non-issue since cached). No console errors on Home/Services/Contact.
